summary: S. 4040, the Dakota Water Resources Act Amendments of 2026, amends Public Law 89-108 to authorize new appropriations for various State, Tribal, municipal, rural, and industrial water supply projects.

affected_groups.effect: Receive authorized funds for water treatment and rural distribution expansion.
Receive authorized funds to complete rural water systems on the Fort Totten, Fort Berthold, Standing Rock, Turtle Mountain, and Lake Traverse Indian Reservations.
affected_groups.group: Tribal nations and members within specific reservations

key_provisions: Authorizes $120,000,000, as indexed, to complete all phases of the Northwest Area Water Supply Biota Water Treatment Plant and Pump Station Project.
Authorizes $404,000,000, as indexed, to complete the McClusky Canal and Missouri River North Alternative for the Eastern North Dakota Alternate Water Supply Project.
Authorizes $50,000,000, as indexed, for the Southwest Pipeline Project for raw water intake, transmission line upgrades, strategic hydraulic improvements, and rural distribution expansion.
Authorizes $63,000,000, as indexed, for North Dakota rural water districts for water treatment and rural distribution expansion.

Authorizes $743,000,000, as indexed, for specific rural water systems on Indian reservations, including the Spirit Lake, Three Affiliated Tribes, Standing Rock, and Turtle Mountain systems, as well as a feasibility study and potential construction for the Lake Traverse system.
Allows fund transfers among certain projects, subject to the limitation that initial authorized amounts for any single project cannot increase by more than 50 percent.
Updates indexing rules to adjust authorized funds for ordinary fluctuations in construction costs.
missing_information: The total net cost or overall budget impact of the legislation when combining all indexed amounts.
Timelines for when the newly authorized projects must begin or finish, other than the two-year deadline for final engineering reports.
summary_detail.plain_summary: S. 4040, the Dakota Water Resources Act Amendments of 2026, amends Public Law 89-108 to authorize new appropriations for various State, Tribal, municipal, rural, and industrial water supply projects.
summary_detail.significance: The bill authorizes substantial new federal funding totaling over $1.3 billion across multiple state and tribal water supply and treatment infrastructure projects in North Dakota and surrounding areas, adjusting cost ceilings and indexing for construction inflation.
